title: Canal Tour Boat | Le Rezzed | Pop Reel!
author: Aequotis

generated.description: A long, open tour boat sitting in a water channel, built mostly from quartz slabs and blocks with dark oak trim and gray stained glass windows. It is about 31 wide, 6 high and 11 deep, with a slim bow and stern and a raised cabin-like top section. Inside the hull there are small details such as red beds, a ladder, a wall sign, and a skull and sign block entity.
